name: How much does it cost to install a raised toilet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install a raised toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a raised toilet varies based on several factors, including the specific toilet model chosen, whether existing plumbing needs modification, and any additional bathroom renovations. Generally, clients can expect costs to include the toilet unit itself, labor for removal of the old toilet, and installation of the new one. If new supply lines or drain work are required, this can add to the total. We provide detailed estimates after assessing your specific bathroom in locations like Daly City or San Bruno.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation cost varies by toilet model, plumbing modifications, and labor. A detailed estimate is provided after an assessment.
